title: Sustainable carbon-based catalysts for oxygen reduction-enhanced FDCA production at ultra-low cell voltage
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22202-22215
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02265G, Paper

Phongphot Sakulaue, Sarinya Woraphutthaporn, Takafumi Ishii, Kanokwan Kongpatpanich, Pongkarn Chakthranont, Khanin Nueangnoraj
A sustainable system coupling ORR with HMF oxidation to FDCA using tea leaf-derived carbon that outperformed Pt/C, achieving an 82% FDCA yield at just 1 V, enabling low-cost, energy-efficient production.
